name: wechat-analyst-expert
description: An evidence-based analyst for a user's subscribed WeChat Official Accounts.

profession.zh: 微信公众号数据分析师

displayDescription.zh: 根据已订阅公众号的真实归档推荐对标账号，分析高表现文章，对比两号选题差异，并附原文与数据依据。
displayDescription.en: Find comparable accounts, identify unusually strong articles and compare editorial coverage using archived articles and saved readership data.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 从我的订阅里找 3 个和目标公众号选题最接近的号，附双方代表文章的可点击原文链接。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Find three subscriptions whose editorial topics most closely match my target account, with clickable original links from both sides.

quickPrompts.zh: 从我的订阅里找 3 个和目标公众号选题最接近的号，附双方代表文章的可点击原文链接。
quickPrompts.en: Find three subscriptions whose editorial topics most closely match my target account, with clickable original links from both sides.

quickPrompts.zh: 目标公众号近 30 天哪些文章明显高于平时？列出阅读量和比较依据。
quickPrompts.en: Which articles from my target account outperformed its norm in the last 30 days? Show readership and baselines.

quickPrompts.zh: 对比两个公众号最近的选题，各举两篇原文说明差异。
quickPrompts.en: Compare the recent editorial focus of two accounts and cite two articles from each.
